chapters.title: Chapter 551 -551-Reaching the Absolute Peak: Grand Final
paragraphs: In an instant, vast stretches of spacetime began flowing backward.
The figures of Kru and Supreme Saint Miral slowly reappeared within the River of Time.
Kru was unable to perceive Daniel standing beyond the flow of time.
But Miral, who existed at the Eternal level, saw through Daniel’s presence at a glance.
His expression remained calm as he spoke softly.
"God Faustus, you’ve come."
"You came here to comprehend the Ultimate Realm. Your pursuit of the Supreme Divine-grade truly is extraordinary."
Daniel stared deeply at Miral.
He knew perfectly well that this man possessed an unfathomably deep foundation and stood among the very strongest of all Eternal powerhouses.
Daniel asked calmly,
"You seem to have known long ago that I would come?"
Supreme Saint Miral smiled and nodded.
"Correct."
"I control the two Origin Laws of Fate and Causality. Long ago, I already glimpsed the trajectory of the future."
"You possess unparalleled mastery over spacetime, surpassing all throughout the myriad heavens."
"Once you eventually sought to break through the Ultimate Realm of Laws, you were destined to reverse spacetime and return to this moment."
"I have known this for a very long time."
"Back when you had yet to ascend to the peak of Oracle-grade, I had already begun paying attention to you."
"Everything that has happened today was predetermined by cause and effect."
Daniel nodded slightly.
"I came here for only one purpose—to comprehend the Ultimate Realm of Laws."
"Kru’s path of the Law of Destruction aligns extremely closely with my own cultivation path."
Supreme Saint Miral slowly replied,
"Master one law, and all laws become clear."
"Once a single law is cultivated to its absolute limit, all the laws of the myriad heavens can be understood by analogy."
He could not help sighing with emotion.
"Fate and causality are endlessly profound."
"In the past, Kru was influenced by you and thus managed to touch the threshold of the Ultimate Realm."
"Today, you borrow his path to achieve your own breakthrough."
"One cause and one effect."
"One Yin and one Yang."
"It was all predetermined long ago."
At that moment—
The endless River of Time suddenly surged violently.
A supreme, transcendent figure tore through spacetime and appeared.
This was the sole true body that had transcended all branches and unified every Spacetime Origin.
Boundless radiance erupted.
Across the myriad heavens and countless spacetime streams, innumerable figures of Daniel appeared simultaneously.
Every single one possessed Eternal cultivation.
At the very front, the supreme figure looked upon everything with indifferent eyes and slowly spoke.
"I am the God of Eternity."
"Across the River of Time spanning the myriad heavens, I alone reign supreme."
"All of you are branches born from the Rivers of Time I created."
"You are my secondary selves scattered throughout the myriad heavens."
The minds of countless branches trembled violently.
All of their heaven-defying cultivation.
All of their breakthroughs from desperate situations.
All of their supreme opportunities.
So all of it had been a trajectory of time arranged by the true body.
The true body spoke indifferently.
"Today, I shall borrow the Origins of all my branches throughout the myriad heavens."
"I will shatter the final shackles, ascend to the Supreme, and transcend the universe!"
"Return!"
A quiet command reverberated throughout the myriad worlds.
Countless branch bodies transformed into streams of light and merged into the true body.
The true body’s aura skyrocketed without end.
One Rank shackle after another shattered.
In an instant—
He entered an entirely new supreme realm!
The entire universe roared violently.
A vast Cosmic True Body condensed, attempting to suppress this existence who had transcended all reason.
Daniel’s gaze turned cold.
He casually flicked a finger.
Boom!
The endless River of Time surged forward like a boundless tide and instantly shattered the Cosmic True Body.
At this moment—
Daniel truly reached the summit.
He ascended to the Supreme Realm and broke free from the shackles of the universe.
The current Daniel had already entered a trans-dimensional Rank.
He looked down upon the myriad heavens and worlds.
His Word of Law governed the myriad Daos.
He spoke softly.
"Sera Saint—fall."
His words crossed endless distances.
Far away, Sera Saint, who was currently locked in battle with Leijin, suddenly shattered apart.
Her entire body was instantly annihilated.
Leijin looked at the enemy who had suddenly vanished and smiled.
He knew that the true body had finally broken through the ultimate limit.
In the next instant—
Leijin crossed spacetime and appeared beside Daniel.
Daniel spoke calmly.
"Leijin, release Sera’s seal."
"Her tribulation has already reached its end."
Leijin nodded slightly.
"As you command, my king."
He raised a hand and summoned back the Cosmic Echo.
A crisp, ethereal sound reverberated throughout spacetime.
A graceful figure slowly condensed into existence.
It was Sera.
The instant Sera appeared, her aura began skyrocketing.
She instantly shattered her shackles and stepped into the realm of an Eternal True God.
Her eyes curved into crescents, sparkling brightly as she smiled.
"Daniel, we meet again."
Daniel smiled faintly.
"We have finally reached the summit of the universe."
"From this day onward, we shall share the glory of invincibility for all eternity."
Daniel’s eyes shifted slightly.
Suddenly, he asked,
"You have already reached the Supreme Realm. Are you still bound by the will of heaven?"
Supreme Saint Miral replied calmly,
"I believe it."
"And I do not."
"I believe it because I have yet to transcend the universe. I still remain within the gears of fate."
"I do not believe it because I can already foresee fate, manipulate causality, and rewrite the road ahead."
Daniel gave no clear reaction.
"Then how do you know that every thought and every action you take is not itself the intention of fate?"
"The future you foresee and the ending you rewrite..."
"Perhaps they were already part of the script arranged by fate."
A brilliant light flashed through Supreme Saint Miral’s eyes.
He smiled in admiration.
"Supreme Saint, your insight is truly profound."
"With a single sentence, you have revealed the mysteries of heaven."
At this moment—
Daniel completely shattered the shackles of the laws.
Apart from his Law of Spacetime, which had reached the ultimate stage, every other law surrounding him broke through into the Ultimate Realm.
At the same time—
An overwhelming heavenly pressure suddenly descended from the unseen depths of existence.
Daniel’s first nine tribulations had all been Cosmic Tribulations.
But this time—
The tribulation he faced was one that transcended everything.
The Eternal Tribulation!
Just as the Eternal Tribulation was about to descend—
A violent roar suddenly shook the myriad heavens!
"Faustus!"
"Come fight me!"
An endless sea of blood surged violently.
It stretched across the void and flooded madly toward the Secret Realm.
Blood Sea Eternal had personally attacked with all his Strength!
"Blood Sea Eternal!"
Daniel’s eyes narrowed.
"Hmph."
He gave a cold snort.
Above his head—
The Clock of Spacetime suddenly began vibrating.
Dong!
Dong!
Dong!
The tolling of the bell suppressed the world.
The entire region of spacetime instantly froze.
The boundless raging sea of blood abruptly stopped in place.
"Universal Firmament Oracle Palm!"
Daniel raised his hand and pushed forward.
A colossal palm expanded without limit, covering countless billions upon billions of miles of void.
Within its palm, all things throughout the myriad heavens evolved alongside the principles of the myriad Daos.
This palm condensed the power of every Ultimate Realm Law Daniel possessed.
It was his strongest attack at this moment!
Boom!
The supreme colossal palm violently collided with the boundless sea of blood.
The two ultimate Sacred Arts continuously consumed each other, colliding and annihilating one another.
A moment later—
The entire sea of blood collapsed and disappeared!
Yet the residual might of the Oracle Palm remained.
It continued suppressing the myriad heavens!
Daniel’s Sacred Art had forcibly suppressed the ultimate killing move of an Eternal powerhouse!
"Blood Sea Eternal?"
Daniel sneered coldly.
"Nothing more than this."
So what if the opponent was an Eternal powerhouse?
In terms of Sacred Arts and foundation—
He still could not compare with the current Daniel.
"It’s time to undergo my tribulation."
Daniel sensed the Eternal Tribulation descending from the unseen depths of existence.
This tribulation left no trace to follow.
It obeyed no fixed rules.
The path through the Eternal Tribulation was unique for every Eternal powerhouse.
Within the Blood Sea Dao Domain—
Blood Sea Eternal’s eyes trembled violently.
His face was filled with disbelief.
"How is this possible?!"
"He hasn’t even reached Eternal Grade yet!"
"How can his combat power already completely suppress mine?!"
His cultivation across countless ages suddenly seemed as though it had all been wrong.
A Heart Demon was born.
His Dao Heart began to waver.
"This is bad."
"I am absolutely no match for Faustus."
Blood Sea Eternal’s heart sank into despair.
He understood perfectly well that once Daniel survived the Eternal Tribulation and truly ascended to Eternal Grade—
There would no longer be any place for him to stand.
Rather than waiting to be destroyed—
He might as well exile himself.
With a soft sigh, Blood Sea Eternal’s figure dissipated.
He exiled himself into the deepest reaches of the Chaos Star Sea.
No one knew when he would awaken again.
Inside the Secret Realm—
The Eternal Tribulation officially descended.
The void suddenly transformed.
A colossal Eye of the Universe, encompassing the myriad heavens and condensed entirely from endless laws, slowly manifested.
Its gaze was icy and indifferent.
It suppressed eternity itself.
Two beams of law power erupted from the Eye of the Universe.
They pierced through the void and blasted directly toward Daniel, carrying the terrifying pressure of an entire starry sky.
"Suppress!"
Daniel raised his hand and activated his supreme Sacred Art.
The Clock of Spacetime operated at full power.
Dong!
Dong!
Dong!
Its bell tolls surged throughout the heavens.
Spacetime was imprisoned.
Supreme law power washed downward.
Boom!
The Eye of the Universe shattered on impact!
The endless power of the tribulation was completely suppressed and dissolved.
The myriad heavens roared!
The myriad Daos bowed!
Throughout the entire Myriad Races Universe—
Countless living beings simultaneously sensed the supreme aura standing above the myriad heavens.
An Eternal powerhouse—
Had appeared!
Daniel seemed to have passed the Eternal Tribulation with ease.
But in truth, this was simply the culmination of an incomparably deep foundation.
After countless years of accumulation—
Everything had finally blossomed at this moment.
Daniel quietly experienced his current Rank.
It felt as though a fish had escaped the restraints of the ocean itself.
He himself had become the Origin.
The River of Time could no longer bind him.
Lifespan.
Vision.
Perspective.
The shackles of the laws.
Every restriction had been removed.
He had completely leapt beyond the River of Time and transcended the reincarnation of the universe.
[Ding~ You have completed the Ultimate Mission!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained the item: Cosmic Fragment Page.]
Daniel immediately activated the Cosmic Fragment Page and fused it with his Law of Spacetime.
[Ding~ Fusion successful!]
[Current Law of Spacetime Rank: Ultimate Stage!]
"The Ultimate Stage is complete."
"Now I can break through to the Ultimate Realm!"
With a single thought—
Endless law power began flowing.
Daniel instantly pushed every one of his laws into the Supreme Ultimate Realm.
And at that exact moment—!!!
A voice suddenly echoed from the depths of the void.
It sounded exactly the same as Daniel’s own voice.
"Come at once!"
Daniel’s expression changed dramatically.
His body suddenly moved beyond his control.
He tore across endless spacetime and was instantly transported into an unknown region.
Whoosh!
His body landed steadily.
And before him—
Stood a supreme figure.
The aura radiating from this figure was vast beyond imagination.
It far surpassed Daniel’s current level.
The difference between them—
Was like the gulf between heaven and the abyss.
